description: Pinned heat layer for deterministic replay: the hottest 2,000 of the CWFIS 24-hour satellite hotspot detections at the retrieval instant, reduced to point geometry and a brightness-derived temp value. The live page uses the full feed; this exists so ?data=snapshot reproduces exactly.
publisher: Natural Resources Canada, Canadian Forest Service - Canadian Wildland Fire Information System (CWFIS)
attribution: Contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence - Canada.
notes: generator is null because no script in pipeline/ produces this file; it was cut by hand from the WFS response, which is the same URL pipeline/live.py issues. Modifications: filtered server-side to the bounding box in the CQL filter, sorted by descending temp, then truncated locally to the hottest 2,000 features. A hotspot is a thermal detection, not a fire and not a fire perimeter. The Information was modified. Natural Resources Canada does not endorse this project and nothing here has official status. This file is a pinned input for tests/golden/: regenerating it changes every golden output.
licenceEvidence: data/snapshot-heat.prov.json; recorded publisher reference https://open.canada.ca/en/open-government-licence-canada. One request on 2026-10-02 failed (403); prior wording retained, not freshly verified.
licenceReason: Existing bundled data decision retained; this repair records attribution and verifies local bytes.
